svg.title: Dual-Plane Real-Time Chat Architecture
svg.desc: Dual-plane stateless and stateful chat architecture showing ZooKeeper service discovery, stateful WebSocket chat servers, presence servers with 30s heartbeat and friend-pair pub/sub, 1-on-1 direct push, group chat sync queues, multi-device cur_max_message_id cursor sync, key-value store, and offline APNs and FCM push notifications.
svg.text: Dual-Plane Real-Time Chat Architecture (500M DAU · 100M Sockets · Sub-250ms Delivery)
Stateless API & ZooKeeper Discovery · Stateful WebSocket Gateways · 30s Heartbeat Presence · cur_max_message_id Multi-Device Sync
2. Dual-Plane Fleet: Stateless API & Stateful Gateways
• User authentication, sign-up, profile and relationship management
• Group chat creation, member roster updates (capped <= 100 members)
• Key Distribution Service: X3DH bundles and MLS group credentials
Queries ZooKeeper discovery to return optimal Chat Gateway URL
• 1-on-1 Chat: Direct push across pinned sockets via internal gRPC
• Group Chat (<=100 users): Writes to per-recipient sync inboxes
• Session refresh: Extends Redis 90s gateway lease on each frame
• 30s heartbeat TTL: Client ping resets Redis key with 90s lease
• 3 missed pings mark user offline (damps cellular network flaps)
• Friend-pair Pub/Sub channels (A-B, A-C) for F <= 500 friends
On-demand pull: Viewport presence queries eliminate celebrity storms
Decoupled from Chat Gateways to protect messaging throughput
• 90s sliding TTL refreshed by active gateway
O(1) lookup to route inbound frames to target node
• 1-on-1 Chat: channel_id = min(u1, u2) || max(u1, u2)
• LSM append-only engine: high write throughput
Permanent chat history with keyset range scans
• Per-recipient message sync queue per active user
• New message condition: recipient == me && id > cur_max
• Multi-device cursor sync: watermarks advance in lockstep
Replays missing frames upon device reconnection
• Triggered when recipient has no active gateway in Redis
• Enqueues alert to Kafka topic: chat-offline-push
• Worker pool dispatches to Apple APNs & Google FCM
Silent push wakes client background thread to pull history
1. Stateless/Stateful Split: Stateless API isolates auth/discovery;
stateful WebSocket Gateways hold active TCP connection state.
2. Hybrid Fan-Out: Direct push & sync queues for groups <= 100;
large channels pull via cur_max_message_id cursors.
